body: [{"arxiv_id":"1808.07501v2","title":"Calibration Scoring Rules for Practical Prediction Training","normalized_lane":"calibration","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Adopt the paper's Practical scoring rule for the analyst/forecaster leaderboard: the log scoring rule is the only strictly proper rule in the paper's practical sense, but its unbounded blowups on near-certain misses are trust-destroying in a public leaderboard; the Practical rule (with the paper's s_min floor) preserves the log rule's incentives while capping the worst single-forecast loss at s_min = -57.27. The operational decision rule is the numeric gate: adopt the Practical rule for the analyst leaderboard only if it preserves the raw-log-score forecaster ranking (Spearman rank correlation >= 0.95) while capping the worst single-forecast loss at -57.27 instead of the log rule's unbounded blowups -- same truth, no trust-destroying single-week disasters. The ledger's extracted §§10-14 were missing; the improvement and gate here are taken from the ledger's stated numeric gate and the paper's practical-scoring-rule construction. Improvement: apply the same bounded-proper-rule treatment to the public board's weekly analyst grades so a single bad forecast can no longer dominate a season-long ranking, and keep raw log score as the internal research metric.","gate":"Adopt the Practical rule for the analyst leaderboard only if it preserves the raw-log-score forecaster ranking (Spearman rank correlation >= 0.95) while capping the worst single-forecast loss at the paper's s_min (-57.27) instead of the log rule's unbounded blowups; otherwise keep the log rule.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"CALIBRATE","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"1809.03561v1","title":"Quantile Regression for Qualifying Match of GEFCom2017 Probabilistic Load Forecasting","normalized_lane":"calibration","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Port the GEFCom2017 probabilistic load-forecasting template to NFL totals and score differentials: decompose log(total) = trend_t + Y_t, where trend = annual moving average of residuals (season scoring environment, rule changes -- the paper's trend_t) and Y via quantile regressions on a deterministic calendar/matchup basis (week-of-season B-splines, rest-differential dummies, weather-band interactions, divisional flags), fitted by pinball minimization at quantiles 0.1-0.9; add trend-quantile uncertainty and exponentiate back. This is the first pinball-evaluated, competition-winning quantile-forecasting method in the corpus -- it produces full predictive distributions (not point estimates), exactly what calibrated totals betting and Kelly sizing need. Evaluate on pinball loss vs GSE's current totals model and the market line; use the distribution for Kelly-staked totals picks and the abstention gates (0714-0720). Improvement: fix the paper's two admitted weaknesses -- (a) quantile-lasso (L1-penalized quantile regression) on an expanded feature set including weather forecasts and team-strength ratings; (b) make the trend component time-varying with structural-break detection (rule-change/season-boundary effects), which the paper's own error analysis flags as the biggest prospective gain.","gate":"ADOPT if the quantile model beats GSE's current totals approach on pinball loss and produces positive backtest ROI. REJECT if the decomposition adds nothing -- i.e., if NFL totals are sufficiently stationary that a single quantile regression without the trend component matches performance (simpler wins).","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"1809.07751","title":"Spline-Based Probability Calibration","normalized_lane":"calibration","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Build SplineCalib as a smoother, data-adaptive replacement for GSE's existing Platt/isotonic post-hoc calibrators (the paper's exact baselines): a stateless post-hoc layer (scipy/numpy + sklearn) taking engine win probabilities (moneyline/spread-cover/total over-under) plus a calibration set of past games with outcomes (rolling 2-3 seasons, time-ordered); fit per-market binary SplineCalib (200 knots, CV L2 logistic on a natural-spline basis) and the compact-logit variant for overconfident sub-models; multi-class extension for 3-way outcomes (e.g., spread buckets); evaluate log-loss/Brier vs the current Platt/isotonic baseline; serve as a stateless function applied at inference. Improvement: combine SplineCalib with Mondrian (conditional) calibration -- fit separate spline calibrators per conditioning bin (favorite/underdog, home/away, high/low total) and compare against a single global spline, testing whether GSE's miscalibration is regime-dependent, which a single global calibrator (the paper's setup) cannot fix.","gate":"ADOPT if SplineCalib (or compact-logit variant) reduces test-window log-loss vs. the best current calibrator by >= 1% relative on BOTH spread and total markets with no accuracy/ROI regression on the posted-pick subset; REJECT if it fails to beat Platt/isotonic on either market or shows calibration-set-size instability (log-loss degrades when calibration window is halved).","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"1809.08016v3","title":"On-field player workload exposure and knee injury risk monitoring via deep learning","normalized_lane":"causal_injury","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"SITUATIONAL","improvement":"Port the deep-learning knee-load estimation pipeline to football ACL-risk monitoring: the paper predicts knee joint moment (KJM) waveforms -- KJMx (ext/flex), KJMy, KJMz (internal/external rotation) -- over the first 33% of stance from encoded marker trajectories (xyz->RGB) via a CaffeNet double-cascade (ImageNet pre-training -> force/moment estimation -> joint-load estimation). Modern GSE port: replace CaffeNet with a temporal CNN/transformer backbone, replace marker trajectories with NGS tracking data (10 Hz player coordinates) or practice wearable IMU streams, target = estimated knee-load proxies or validated workload-exposure scores per player per week; train on lab-grade biomechanics mocap data with force plates as ground truth (data partnership is the long pole); serve weekly batch workload-exposure reports for fantasy/injury-risk content (real-time later). Focus is the ACL-relevant rotational component KJMz -- the paper already shows ext/flex KJMx is easy (r~0.99) and least injury-relevant. Improvement: target the weak component with a physics-informed loss term penalizing violations of the inverse-dynamics relationship between predicted KJM and measured GRF (same trials), extra weight on KJMz -- hypothesis: KJMz correlation improves >=0.05 without degrading KJMx/KJMy because GRF coupling is strongest in the rotational channel.","gate":"Adopt if the modern-backbone port beats linear regression on KJMz (the ACL-relevant rotational component) by >=0.05 correlation with 5-fold CIs excluding zero on held-out subjects; reject if the gain is confined to ext/flex (KJMx), which the paper already shows is easy (r~0.99) and least injury-relevant.","owner":"Hermes","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"1810.00908","title":"A Statistical Exploration of Duckworth-Lewis Method Using Bayesian Inference","normalized_lane":"weather","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"SITUATIONAL","improvement":"Port the Bayesian monotone-constrained table machinery to GSE's live engine: module live/interruption_adjustment.py adapting the Duckworth-Lewis framework to football -- define game-state resources R(t, s, to): expected remaining point differential given minutes remaining t, score differential s, timeouts remaining to; fit R_bar(t,s,to) ~ N(m(t,s,to;theta), sigma^2/n) with order-constrained priors (the paper's Eq. 7 construction: chain uniform priors on successive levels) enforcing monotonicity: increasing in own timeouts, decreasing in deficit, increasing in time remaining. Application 1: lightning-delayed/suspended games -- fair evaluation of game state at interruption (grading picks on suspended games, resume probabilities); Application 2: monotone win-probability surface for the live engine -- replace any non-monotone empirical WP table with the constrained Bayesian version. The prior construction is a reusable recipe wherever GSE needs a bivariate surface that must be monotone. Improvement: the paper's stated future work -- replace parametric m(u,w) with a monotone Gaussian process (or monotone spline) over (time, score diff, timeouts) keeping Eq. 7-style order priors on inducing values; hypothesis: the nonparametric monotone surface captures football-specific structure (2-minute-warning, 4th-quarter comeback nonlinearity) while retaining exact monotonicity; success = GP wins by >=3% RMSE in the last 5 minutes of games, becoming GSE's live-engine WP surface.","gate":"ADOPT the monotone table if (a) out-of-sample RMSE beats the unconstrained empirical table by >= 2% (the constraint acts as regularization, mirroring the paper's RSS win), (b) monotonicity holds exactly across all cells, and (c) the table's implied win probabilities are calibrated (ECE <= 0.02 on holdout). REJECT if the constraint doesn't improve generalization -- with NFL sample sizes, the prior may over-smooth real structure.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"1810.08032v1","title":"Augmenting Adjusted Plus-Minus in Soccer with FIFA Ratings","normalized_lane":"tracking","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"INFRA","improvement":"Build Madden-Prior Player Value (MPPV): the Augmented-APM idea -- regularize noisy on-field player-value estimates toward a subjective rating prior, with the data deciding the weight via a learned scale alpha (the paper's equation 3). Unit of analysis = the drive (response = drive EPA/points; design matrix X = skill-position players on the drive, OL as unit effect); prior beta|alpha ~ N(alpha . madden_overall_centered, tau^2), alpha ~ N(mu_alpha, sigma^2_alpha) with Madden overall ratings (preseason, mean-centered per position group) as the FIFA-ratings analogue; learn alpha per position group; fit in Stan/PyMC on 2019-2024 nflverse drives; time-weight by drives. Products: weekly 'Madden vs. reality' content -- players whose posterior beta most exceeds/falls short of their Madden-implied prior -- and a one-number player-value leaderboard with posterior uncertainty intervals (the paper's Bayesian advantage over point-estimate plus-minus). Improvement beyond the paper: (a) dynamic prior -- weekly Kalman-filtered blend of preseason Madden rating and cumulative posterior (the paper's prior never updates and its own rolling analysis shows the prior's value decays); (b) component ratings (Madden speed/awareness/catching by position) instead of the single overall -- the paper discarded FIFA's components. This is also the natural bridge to GSE's state-space team-strength work (1701.05976).","gate":"Adopt MPPV as a GSE player-valuation metric if on the 2023-2024 rolling holdout it beats both the Madden-only and the zero-prior ridge baselines on drive-EPA MSE in both seasons (the paper's result replicated, not a one-season fluke) AND the learned position-group alpha's are positive and stable (prior genuinely informative, not washed out). Reject if MPPV fails to beat zero-prior ridge (the prior adds nothing once on-field data accumulates) or if alpha ~ 0 (Madden ratings carry no signal for drive EPA).","owner":"Hermes","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"1810.12068v2","title":"Modelling rankings in R: the PlackettLuce package","normalized_lane":"markets","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"BASELINE","improvement":"Adopt the Plackett-Luce ranking machinery (the R PlackettLuce package's statistical engine, re-implemented in GSE's stack) as an honesty harness for early-season NFL ratings: pseudo-regularized ratings fitted on the partial-season matchup graph, evaluated on held-out log-likelihood -- i.e., do not trust the early-season leaderboard until a regularized model beats the unregularized one out of sample. Operational rule (BASELINE): before any early-season pick-confidence tier is published from weeks 1-4 ratings, run the pseudo-regularization check; report quasi-SEs (the package's quasi-standard-errors) rather than naive SEs whenever they change a published confidence tier. This is infrastructure, not a signal -- the objective is not to beat the engine, it is to stop the engine from publishing overconfident claims from 4-game samples. The ledger's extracted §§10-14 were missing; the improvement and gate are taken from the ledger's stated numeric gate.","gate":"ADAPT confirmed if pseudo-regularized early-season NFL ratings beat unregularized on weeks 5-8 held-out log-likelihood (any positive margin with p<0.1), OR if quasi-SEs change at least one published pick-confidence tier vs naive SEs; otherwise keep the current early-season rating procedure.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"1811.03931v1","title":"Risk-Neutral Pricing and Hedging of In-Play Football Bets","normalized_lane":"experimental","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Build GSE's risk-neutral in-play pricer for live NFL totals: port the soccer goal-Poisson to a drive-level scoring process -- each drive is a 'jump' with points {0,2,3,6,7,8}, modeled as a marked point process with time-varying intensity lambda(t, score-diff, field-position regime); define tradable underlyings as compensated drive-point processes (the paper's S^1_t, S^2_t construction); calibrate lambda to live market totals (consensus books) by bid-ask-weighted least squares -- yielding implied scoring intensities per team per game state; compute in-play deltas (dX on next score for each team) and hedge live total exposure with 'next score' props (the direct analogue of Next Goal bets, which books actually offer). Start with the constant-intensity closed forms (Poisson sums, Eq. 14) as the baseline pricer; upgrade to CIR-stochastic intensity per Jottreau 2009 once the desk needs it. train the semantic AAE with the latent partitioned into intention (route-concept class, charted), physicality/aggressiveness (speed/accel-derived), residual; decoder reconstructs trajectories (smooth-L1), discriminators regularize partitions; deploy two heads: (a) reconstruction-error anomaly flag for data QA, (b) semantic factors as features for GSE prop models; supervised contrastive variant: contrast normal plays vs synthetically perturbed plays (PGD-style waypoint jitter) to harden the trajectory forecaster — then switch to football-native anomaly synthesis (swap a player's trajectory with a different play's same-position trajectory — context-inconsistent but realistic) and run the adversarial loop: train the ball-carrier forecaster on AAE-flagged hardest legitimate plays to test whether 'legitimate hard examples' improve tail performance.","gate":"ADOPT iff: (a) anomaly-detection ROC AUC >= 0.85 on synthetic perturbations (vs <= 0.70 for the raw-acceleration baseline), AND (b) the intention partition achieves AMI >= 0.30 with charted route concepts; REJECT if (a) fails.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"large","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2303.05774v1","title":"NFL Career Success as Predicted by NFL Scouting Combine","normalized_lane":"props_dfs","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Use the combine paper as a NEGATIVE prior in GSE's rookie model: cap combine-feature weights in rookie-season projections — do not let 40-yard dash / 3-cone standouts move rookie fantasy projections materially; draft-market angle: fade rookies whose draft slot was driven by combine testing over college production for rookie-season props (rookie of the year, season-long yardage props), favor productive college players with mediocre testing; concrete rule: rookie projection blend weight = alpha*college production + beta*draft position + gamma*combine with gamma <= 0.1 and 3-cone excluded or signed near-zero for RB/WR/TE, broad jump allowed small positive weight (only drill with any success signal) — then run position-specific combine validity (per position group with position-relevant success metrics) to test whether the null is a pooling artifact and whether any drill x position cell has real predictive power worth a nonzero weight.","gate":"ADAPT iff Test 1 replicates (combine predicts matriculation at 0.78-0.88 accuracy but snaps R2 < 0.25 — the negative prior stands regardless of Test 2); REJECT only if combine metrics strongly predict success on modern classes (R2 >= 0.35 without production features), which would overturn the paper; the adaptation is a modeling constraint, not a predictor — judge it on whether GSE's rookie projections avoid the combine trap, not on a new edge.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"small","depends_on":[]}]

If reproduction fails to beat baselines on modern data, verdict falls back to REJECT (superseded by 2503.18589-class methods).","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"large","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2303.11366v4","title":"Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning","normalized_lane":"llm_agents_ai_scientist","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Adapt the Actor-Evaluator-Self-Reflection triad as the executor harness inside the AI-Scientist discovery loop: Actor = code-writing agent editing the nflverse backtest template; Evaluator = deterministic backtest returning binary/scalar signal plus structured diagnostics (which season folds failed, sample sizes, calibration slope), with a permutation-based evaluator-reliability check (flip the feature's sign / permute the target - if the 'signal' persists, flag it); Self-Reflection = LLM writing 3-5 sentence lessons into a bounded SQLite memory (Omega=3) retrieved by similarity - with reflection consolidation every 5 trials, distilling stored reflections into one durable 'doctrine' entry while raw reflections expire.","gate":"ADOPT if: reflection arm resolves >=6/10 ideas within 12 trials vs <=3/10 for the retry-only arm, mean trials-to-pass is lower in the reflection arm, and the permutation-based evaluator-reliability check flags >=80% of deliberately injected leaky backtests; REJECT the reflection layer if the retry-only arm matches within 1 idea, or reflection shows the Table-3 pathology, or reflections duplicate each other (cosine > 0.9 across trials).","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INVENT","effort":"small","depends_on":["2408.06292v3"]},{"arxiv_id":"2303.12401v2","title":"Real-time forecasting within soccer matches through a Bayesian lens","normalized_lane":"bayesian","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Port the live Bayesian probit to NFL: replace the 90 independent minute-models with a hierarchical Bayesian structure (minute-level coefficients shrunk toward neighbors), play-indexed probits on nflverse (down/distance/yardline/score/time covariates), and add market odds as a covariate to test whether live events add information beyond the price.","gate":"ADAPT iff the architecture survives chronological evaluation: under rolling-origin validation, the play-indexed Bayesian probit must beat a static pre-match-probability-plus-score baseline on log-loss; if the live model adds nothing once the split is chronological, the adaptation fails.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2303.14857v1","title":"Paired comparisons for games of chance","normalized_lane":"team_ratings","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Adapt only the luck function: replace GSE's BT/Elo win-probability link p=1/(1+10^(-Delta/400)) with the beta-capped link p=(1-beta)/2+beta/(1+10^(-Delta/400)), beta tuned on 2015-2025 nflverse moneylines (grid {0.8,0.85,0.9,0.95,1.0}) - applied at the calibration layer (predicted prob -> market prob), not inside the rating update, keeping the existing Elo/Glicko machinery untouched - then test team-specific beta via hierarchical beta_team with shrinkage to the global mean, kept only if beta_team is stable year-over-year (rank correlation >0.3).","gate":"ADOPT the beta-capped link if it reduces tail-decile log-loss by >=0.002 vs beta=1 on 2015-2025 pooled AND improves overall log-loss (no overall degradation); ADAPT if it wins only in the tail - apply the cap only for |p-0.5|>0.3 (piecewise link); REJECT if beta<1 does not beat beta=1 on NFL data.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2303.16648v1","title":"Beating the average: how to generate profit by exploiting the inefficiencies of soccer betting","normalized_lane":"experimental","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Build a 'coverage calculator' for GSE contest products (survivor pools, pick'em pools, correlated parlay portfolios): given m published picks with heterogeneous per-pick hit rates p_i from GSE's calibrated probabilities, payout tiers, entry cost, and desired safety Q, output the number of portfolio entries and their construction - generalizing the paper's eq 15 to heterogeneous p_i via the Poisson-binomial, adding a variance-aware gate (Sharpe ratio of the coverage strategy over the 1.5-year return distribution instead of expected profit alone), and sizing entries to expected closing-line value of each pick subject to the coverage constraint.","gate":"Adopt the coverage calculator if, on the 10,000-draw simulation using GSE's calibrated per-pick probabilities, empirical coverage at the computed n matches the target Q within +/-1 pp across Q in {90%, 99%, 99.9%} AND the expected-profit sign matches the formula's prediction on historical pick'em data; reject if heterogeneity in p_i breaks the approximation beyond +/-3 pp.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2303.16741v1","title":"Who You Play Affects How You Play: Predicting Sports Performance Using Graph Attention Networks With Temporal Convolution","normalized_lane":"experimental","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"INFRA","improvement":"Build an NFL analog: nodes = key players per matchup (skill players, QBs, pass rushers, coverage defenders); weighted edges from FTN charting (coverage matchup minutes, alignment, shadow-coverage indicators) instead of the paper's binary complete graph; node features from nflverse per-player-per-game aggregates; GATv2 + TCN on 8-17 week windows; target = next-week player fantasy/prop-relevant stats - with a market-conditioning head (de-vigged prop line embeddings concatenated to node features so attention routes around mispriced lines) and a multi-task target (yards + receptions + TD jointly).","gate":"Adopt as GSE's prop-graph lane if GATv2-TCN beats the TCN-only baseline by >=5% MAE reduction on 2024 WR receiving yards AND CORR improves by >=0.03 absolute on the test window, with no MAPE deterioration >10%; reject the graph component if it fails to beat TCN; reject the whole approach if it fails to beat GSE's existing per-player features.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2303.16776v1","title":"Supervised Learning for Table Tennis Match Prediction","normalized_lane":"experimental","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Port the pattern, not the sport: NFL analogs of the engineered features - pass-vs-run EPA differential (offense balance), short-vs-long down EPA differential, home/road splits differentials, early-vs-late-down efficiency gaps, and a BALANCE metric (mean of absolute differentials) as a team 'well-roundedness' feature - plus the RANKDIFF non-linearity (saturation applied to Elo-difference features) and the anti-overfit protocol: for every matchup-level feature, compute it from rolling aggregates EXCLUDING the target game (leave-one-game-out) and verify accuracy parity - a cheap leakage audit for the props/engine pipeline.","gate":"Adopt the differential-feature + LOO-audit pattern if: (a) BALANCE-style features rank in the top half of RF Gini importance on NFL data, and (b) LOO-aggregated features lose <=5 percentage points of accuracy vs leaky features; reject if differentials add nothing over GSE's existing EPA aggregates, or if the LOO audit reveals GSE's current matchup features are leaking target-game data.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2303.17610","title":"Ensemble weather forecast post-processing with a flexible probabilistic neural network approach","normalized_lane":"weather","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"SITUATIONAL","improvement":"Build weather/postprocess.py: train an ANET2_NORM-style model (fastest MVP) on GEFS/ECMWF-IFS ensemble reforecasts for 30 NFL stadium coordinates - targets = game-time 2m temperature, 10m wind speed, precipitation rate; inputs = ensemble mean/variance at ~6-hour lead times bracketing kickoff, stadium altitude/lon/lat, day-of-year encoding - upgrading to the full spline-flow output once the NORM baseline validates; serve nightly calibrated predictive distributions per Sunday game, feeding P(wind > 15 mph), E[precip], temp quantiles into the totals/spread model - plus stadium-bowl microclimate: bowl openness index, field orientation, surrounding elevation for per-stadium bias corrections.","gate":"ADOPT if the post-processed model beats EMOS by >=5% CRPS on wind speed AND >=5% on temperature on the 2024 holdout with rank histograms visibly more uniform than raw ensembles; REJECT if CRPS gain <5% on either variable - then GSE stays with off-the-shelf weather APIs.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2303.17863v2","title":"A Bayesian hidden Markov model for assessing the hot hand phenomenon in basketball shooting performance","normalized_lane":"team_ratings","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Port BLHMM to NFL drive/play sequences: latent states {cold, hot} for offensive efficiency; observation = per-play success (EPA>0 or first-down conversion) with covariates (down, distance, field position, QB injury flag, weather); logit transition probabilities with game-level covariates (opponent defensive strength, rest) to fix the paper's missing-opponent flaw - outputting posterior streak probabilities feeding live in-game win-probability adjustments and a 'momentum flag' for content (never as a primary pick input) - with a three-state (cold/neutral/hot) extension preventing the degenerate 'hot = automatic' collapse.","gate":"ADOPT as a live-momentum module if the HMM beats the no-HMM baseline by >=0.005 mean log-loss on held-out games AND the posterior hot-state probability is calibrated (slope of observed vs predicted next-drive TD rate within 0.85-1.15); ADAPT if only the streak-quantification outputs are useful (content feature, no pick use); REJECT if the latent states degenerate as in the paper on NFL data.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2304.01239v1","title":"Online Distillation with Continual Learning for Cyclic Domain Shifts","normalized_lane":"continual_online_learning","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Teacher-student weekly update: the teacher is GSE's full-history calibrated model (refit monthly); the student is a lightweight model refit weekly on recent games but trained against the teacher's predicted probabilities (soft targets), not hard outcomes - preserving calibration while tracking the current regime fast; serve the student, falling back to the teacher when the student's regime-OOD score is high - with a cyclic replay buffer guaranteeing minimum representation of each regime stratum (early/mid/December-weather/playoffs) from prior seasons, RWalk-style drift regularization on the top-K features, and a regime-conditional teacher variant (4 frozen regime teachers, distilling against the upcoming regime's teacher each week).","gate":"ADOPT the teacher-student update if on 2020-2025 walk-forward: (i) the distilled student matches or beats hard-label refit on anytime Brier while improving ECE by >=0.002, (ii) adding the cyclic buffer + RWalk improves December/playoff-regime Brier by >=0.003 with no metric worse by >0.001; REJECT distillation if the student's edge comes only from the teacher's information (teacher-frozen-since-August control); REJECT the RWalk half if it adds nothing over the buffer alone.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"medium","depends_on":["2308.03810","2405.04101"]},{"arxiv_id":"2304.01538","title":"A doubly self-exciting Poisson model for describing scoring levels in NBA basketball","normalized_lane":"bayesian","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Adapt the doubly self-exciting hierarchy to NFL: game level - weekly player fantasy points (or team points) with INGARCH(1,1) + spread/total/home covariates; drive level - points per drive within a game with the weekly posterior mean as offset; self-excitation parameters (kappa, eta) per player/team quantifying 'hot' volume dynamics; cluster players by (eta, kappa) posteriors for matchup typing (relevant to live betting and DFS late-swap decisions) - with a joint (not two-stage) Bayesian fit propagating game-level uncertainty, zero-inflated Poisson for scoreless drives, and attempt-volume vs efficiency decomposition.","gate":"ADOPT the doubly self-exciting hierarchy and the Wasserstein-barycenter divide-and-conquer if drive-level DSE beats baseline on 2025 held-out log-likelihood; REJECT game-level self-excitation unless WAIC/LOO supports it (the paper's own evidence says it usually does not); REJECT the plug-in offset as a final implementation - propagate uncertainty jointly in the production version.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2304.03870","title":"ASPEST: Bridging the Gap Between Active Learning and Selective Prediction","normalized_lane":"abstention","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Build the weekly ASPEST loop: (a) maintain a checkpoint ensemble of the pick model (shared snapshot infrastructure); (b) each week rank the slate by ensemble margin (uncertainty); (c) spend the 'label budget' - analyst deep-review time, e.g. 5 games/week - on the most uncertain games after they resolve, producing gold-standard graded features/notes; (d) fine-tune the model on the reviewed games + self-train on high-confidence pseudo-labels; (e) re-estimate uncertainty and set the week's gate - with market-aware acquisition: prioritize games where ensemble uncertainty is high AND the market line disagrees with the model (the market is a free second labeler).","gate":"ADAPT accepted if the ASPEST loop beats the static baseline by >= 3 AUACC points on shifted deployment windows AND the analyst-review hours stay within the 5-game budget; else REJECT (keep periodic retraining, drop the active machinery).","owner":"Hermes","bucket":"DECIDE","effort":"small","depends_on":["2205.13532"]},{"arxiv_id":"2304.04437","title":"Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation for Sports Broadcasts using Partial Sports Field Registration","normalized_lane":"sports_cv","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Build a ray-cast 3D pose pipeline for NFL broadcasts: partial sports-field registration to anchor monocular 3D lifting, anchored with Next Gen Stats player (x,y) positions as hard positional constraints (GSE-exclusive data the paper never had) - replacing the ground-plane interpolation step with NGS ground truth - measuring 3D error reduction vs the pure-vision pipeline, directly testing whether GSE's data moat unlocks the kinematic validity the paper was chasing.","gate":"Ray-cast method must beat MeTRAbs by >=3 cm on 3D error AND >=8 deg on knee-angle error on the synthetic football-field set (matching the paper's own margins: 10.33->6.41 cm, 20.31->9.91 deg) with reprojection error <=3 px, before any real-broadcast pilot; if geometry-injection does not beat MeTRAbs off-the-shelf by those margins, the extra pipeline complexity is unjustified.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2304.05242","title":"Generation of Threat: Crediting Football Players for Creating Dangerous Actions in an Unbiased Way","normalized_lane":"props_dfs","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Build GSE's sequence-credit engine for red-zone-entry/explosive-play generation: construct NFL threat processes from ball-touch equivalents (targets, carries) per personnel slot + red-zone-entry/explosive-play timestamps, fit a 12-dim Hawkes process with exponential kernels, and compute the four GoT indices per player with parametric-bootstrap SEs - used as sequence-credit features in fantasy projection models (especially for TEs/FBs/role players whose box scores understate contribution) and weekly 'hidden threat generators' DFS content - with opponent-strength and game-state covariates on the baseline intensities (marked Hawkes) and a position-varying danger-area definition.","gate":"Gate (ADAPT): simulation shows reliable estimation from 600 min (0.4% FP, 18.6% rel. error); case studies must recover both stars and hidden contributors; improvement success = opponent/team confounding reduced (defenders' GoT drops toward the low tier) while offensive rankings stay stable.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2304.05294v5","title":"Selecting Robust Features for Machine Learning Applications using Multidata Causal Discovery","normalized_lane":"causal_discovery","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Run multidata causal feature selection on the nflverse team-week panel: tigramite M-PC1 over team-seasons (2015-2023) with target = next-week game outcome margin/cover, stringent alpha_PC swept {0.01, 0.001}, min lag 1 week; keep the driver set and train GSE's outcome model on drivers only, with quarterly driver-set refresh - plus stratified multidata discovery: run M-PC1 separately within scheme clusters (pass-heavy vs run-heavy offenses, dome vs outdoor teams) and union the driver sets with cluster-membership interactions, testing whether stratified pooling recovers scheme-specific drivers that global pooling washes out.","gate":"ADOPT multidata causal feature selection if: (a) driver-set model Brier on 2023-2025 <= all-features Brier using <=50% of features; (b) validation Brier strictly better than lagged-correlation selection at matched feature count; (c) driver sets from odd-season vs even-season ensembles have Jaccard >= 0.5; reject if (b) fails or Jaccard < 0.4 (fall back to per-team discovery).","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2304.06333v2","title":"Priors for Symbolic Regression","normalized_lane":"symreg_equation_discovery","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Build a SPORTS corpus: collect ~100-200 published sports-analytics formulas (passer rating, QBR components, EPA models, DVOA-style expressions, Elo update rules, Pythagorean expectation variants, target-share formulas), parse to operator trees, train the n-gram LM prior (sibling+ancestor phrases, left/right back-off) - then run the selection pipeline: PySR Pareto front -> for each candidate, Laplace-approximated log-evidence with uniform parameter priors + LM log-prior -> rank by -log P(f_i) - log Z, compared against plain accuracy ranking - with a corpus-ablation experiment: train separate pre-2015 and post-2015 priors and test which selects better-generalizing equations for 2024-2025 data.","gate":"ADOPT the LM-prior selector if its top-3 picks achieve >=10% lower held-out RMSE than the top-3 picks of plain best-fit selection on the 2024-2025 window AND it never ranks a degenerate (constant-only/single-input) equation in the top 5; REJECT if the sports corpus prior underperforms MDL or shows the Nguyen-8 pathology.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2304.09918v2","title":"Smart Sports Predictions via Hybrid Simulation: NBA Case Study","normalized_lane":"win_spread_total","verdict":"ADOPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Two workstreams: (a) per-predictor lookback-window ablation - sweep trailing windows N in {4,6,8,10,13,17 games} for each core GSE predictor family (EPA/play differentials, success rate, pressure rate) on 2015-2024 nflverse, picking per-predictor N by held-out log-loss; (b) incentive-adjusted season simulation - add rule-based modifiers for weeks 16-18: teams locked into playoff seeds get a strength discount, eliminated-but-alive-for-draft-pick teams get a smaller discount, with the discount magnitudes FIT as parameters by maximizing held-out likelihood on historical meaningless games (separately for 'seed locked' vs 'eliminated', home/away), then checked against observable proxies (starter snap-shares in those games).","gate":"ADOPT per-predictor windows if, pre-registered: the swept window improves pooled held-out log-loss by >= 0.003 over the fixed window on 2019-2024, with gains in >= 4 of 6 seasons. ADOPT incentive modifiers if they improve log-loss on the 'locked/eliminated' week 16-18 subset by >= 0.01 without degrading the 'meaningful' subset. REJECT either workstream if its gate fails.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2304.12654v1","title":"CoDi: Co-evolving Contrastive Diffusion Models for Mixed-type Tabular Synthesis","normalized_lane":"synthetic_data","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"INFRA","improvement":"Stand up CoDi as the fallback/alternative synthetic-season generator if TabDDPM's cross-type correlations gate fails: same nflverse game-level table but keeping discrete features native (venue type, surface, weather bin, rest category, game-script regime) - continuous diffusion on EPA/pace/market numerics, discrete diffusion on the categorical block, co-evolving conditioning both directions, contrastive negatives via Method 3 (shuffle discrete blocks across games so the triplet loss learns weather x efficiency pairings matter), quantile transform for long-tailed margin/EPA features - with market-aware negatives: pair a game's efficiency vector with the weather/discrete block of a game from a DIFFERENT spread bucket, teaching the model that discrete-continuous correlations are regime-dependent.","gate":"ADOPT CoDi over TabDDPM if BOTH: (a) real+CoDi-synthetic beats real+TabDDPM-synthetic by >=0.002 log-loss on held-out 2024, OR ties within 0.001 while (b) cross-type correlation MAE is >=10% lower for CoDi; REJECT (stay with TabDDPM) if neither holds, if training instability appears (triplet loss non-convergence across 2+ seeds), or fidelity marginals breach the 5% TVD rule.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2304.14774v3","title":"A Feature Selection Method Based on Shapley Values Robust to Concept Shift in Regression","normalized_lane":"auto_feature_eng","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Run SHAPEffects backward elimination on the gse-lab metric set (~60-80 features) with LightGBM + TreeSHAP, margin-of-victory-vs-spread as the regression target: train on seasons <= S-2, validation = season S-1 (current regime), q_low/q_high in {(0.25,0.75),(0.1,0.9)}, keeping the better-validation config - outputting a pruned feature set per season plus a 'regime-casualty report' of eliminated features with their negative-influence magnitude for the DFS packet - with adaptive quantile thresholds set from the validation error distribution's own tail mass, and a classification extension via the same local logic on log-loss residuals (grouping by signed log-loss residual quantiles).","gate":"Adopt SHAPEffects pruning iff on the 2024 and 2025 held-out test seasons it reduces MAE vs the full-feature baseline by >= 0.15 points AND beats Boruta/Lasso on at least one of the two seasons, with the elimination list stable (>=50% overlap) across the two runs; reject if it merely matches SOTA selectors, eliminates >40% of features, or the dropped-feature sign check fails.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2305.01120v3","title":"LST-Bench: Benchmarking Log-Structured Tables in the Cloud","normalized_lane":"data_infra","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"INFRA","improvement":"Apply the findings to GSE's Delta lake: (1) default to Delta Lake CoW (read-heavy: weekly bulk feature builds, constant point-in-time reads); (2) maintenance doctrine - schedule Optimize (compaction) + Vacuum after every weekly feature build; (3) write-path discipline - configure the Spark/DuckDB writer for large target file sizes (avoid small-file pathology); (4) track S_DR on weekly feature-build latency and Sunday serving-read p99, alerting if S_DR > 0.1 over 4 weeks as the lake-health KPI; (5) rely on time travel for point-in-time replay tests - plus workload-aware compaction: Z-ordering/compaction keyed on (season, week) so hot recent partitions are optimally laid out while cold history is compacted rarely.","gate":"ADOPT the maintenance doctrine iff: (i) the no-maintenance run shows S_DR > 0.1 (confirming the degradation mechanism applies to GSE's workload - if no degradation appears at GSE's scale, the doctrine is REJECTED as over-engineering), AND (ii) post-Optimize latency recovers to within 10% of the fresh-table baseline.","owner":"Hermes","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},{"arxiv_id":"2305.01582v3","title":"Interpretable Machine Learning for Science with PySR and SymbolicRegression.jl","normalized_lane":"symreg_equation_discovery","verdict":"ADOPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Wire the PySR pipeline: nflverse play-by-play 2015-2025 -> game/team-season aggregates (net EPA/play, success rate, explosive-play rate, air yards/attempt, pressure rate allowed, sack rate, turnover margin proxy, 3rd-down conversion); # 1. Load all output records and map by arxiv_id
out = {}
with open("/home/hatch/workspace/improve-ledger-work/part-7.jsonl") as f:
    for ln, line in enumerate(f, 1):
        r = json.loads(line)
        out[r["arxiv_id"]] = r

# 2. Source chunk order
chunk = [json.loads(l) for l in open("/home/hatch/workspace/vendor/Sports/docs/research/2026-09-21/arxiv-program/index/corpus-index.jsonl")][1074:1251]
src_ids = [c["arxiv_id"] for c in chunk]
print("source chunk records:", len(chunk), "| unique ids:", len(set(src_ids)))

# 3. Check every source id is present
missing = [i for i in src_ids if i not in out]
print("missing ids:", missing)

# 4. Emit in exact source order
with open("/home/hatch/workspace/improve-ledger-work/part-7.jsonl.reordered", "w") as f:
    for c in chunk:
        f.write(json.dumps(out[c["arxiv_id"]]) + "\n")
print("reordered file written")

# 5. Validate the reordered file
req = {"arxiv_id","title","normalized_lane","verdict","doctrine_tag","improvement","gate","owner","bucket","effort","depends_on"}
lines = open("/home/hatch/workspace/improve-ledger-work/part-7.jsonl.reordered").read().splitlines()
print("reordered line count:", len(lines))
ok = True
ids = []
for n, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
    r = json.loads(line)

    if set(r.keys()) != req:
        print("KEY MISMATCH line", n, set(r.keys()) ^ req); ok = False
    if r["owner"] not in ("Hermes","Mimo","Motif-lab"):
        print("BAD OWNER line", n, r["owner"]); ok = False
    if r["effort"] not in ("small","medium","large"):

print("unique ids:", len(set(ids)) == len(ids))
# copied-field check vs index
mismatch = 0
for c, r in zip(chunk, [json.loads(l) for l in lines]):
    for k in ("arxiv_id","title","normalized_lane","verdict","doctrine_tag"):
        if c[k] != r[k]:
            print("FIELD MISMATCH", c["arxiv_id"], k); mismatch += 1; ok = False

{"arxiv_id":"2407.15900","title":"Improving Probabilistic Forecasts of Extreme Wind Speeds by Training Statistical Post-Processing Models with Weighted Scoring Rules","normalized_lane":"weather","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"SITUATIONAL","improvement":"Train GSE's weather post-processing models with tail-weighted twCRPS plus pooled EMOS-style combination, but set the weight threshold at value-weighted points (totals near key numbers, regions of historically largest GSE edge) rather than climatological quantiles, so the tail focus lands where the money is.","gate":"ADOPT the twCRPS + pooling pipeline if the 90th-percentile twCRPS skill gain is ≥1% with body degradation ≤0.5% on the 2024–2025 test; REJECT pure-twCRPS training (no pooling) if body CRPS degrades >1%.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},

Reject if the gain concentrates only in top seats.","owner":"Hermes","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},

Try sPoRT!","normalized_lane":"causal_injury","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"SITUATIONAL","improvement":"Make sPoRT a mandatory pre-analysis gate for all GSE longitudinal causal work, stabilized with 50 bootstrap refits reporting flag frequency per subgroup instead of a binary flag, each stable flag linked to an automatic remedy (narrow treatment definition, trim subgroup, or switch to a stochastic-intervention estimand) in a generated causal-readiness report.","gate":"ADAPT sPoRT as a mandatory pre-analysis gate for longitudinal causal work if the LT test (§12) runs cleanly and surfaces at least one actionable support gap. REJECT it as a standalone deliverable.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2412.10298v1","title":"Buzz to Broadcast: Predicting Sports Viewership Using Social Media Engagement","normalized_lane":"nlp","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Forecast GSE content viewership with a hierarchical Bayesian model — sport-level and team-level random effects plus social-buzz features as population-level predictors — so buzz explains within-tier variation instead of the sport one-hot secretly pooling viewership tiers.","gate":"Adopt the feature recipe only if the fixed pipeline beats the team-mean baseline by ≥15% MAE on the 2024 forward test AND held-sport-out R² > 0.5; reject if the signal disappears once the sport one-hot and random split are removed.","owner":"Hermes","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2412.10871v1","title":"Fully Test-time Adaptation for Tabular Data (FtaT)","normalized_lane":"continual_online_learning","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Add a conditional label-shift correction as a standing pre-game post-processing step: estimate base rates per slate archetype (divisional-heavy slates, bad-weather weeks, prime-time slates) from history and correct each week's predictions against its archetype's base rate, since NFL label shift is structured, not global.","gate":"ADOPT the label-shift correction as a standing pre-game post-processing step if on 2020–2025 walk-forward: (i) it reduces slate-level calibration drift (|mean p − base rate|) by ≥30% vs uncorrected, (ii) weekly Brier does not worsen by >0.001, (iii) ECE improves or is neutral.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2412.11158v1","title":"Early Concept Drift Detection via Prediction Uncertainty","normalized_lane":"continual_online_learning","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Replace blunt refit-on-alarm with PU-index-weighted forgetting: weight training samples by an exponential forgetting factor keyed to the chi-square drift evidence, keeping old weeks at reduced weight instead of discarding them, since NFL regimes recur (returning QBs, seasonal weather) rather than being truly novel.","gate":"ADOPT the detector into the weekly pipeline if, on 2020–2025 nflverse history: (i) PUDD fires ≥1 week earlier than the error-rate baseline on ≥60% of known regime-change episodes, (ii) false-alarm rate ≤2/season, and (iii) the drift-triggered refit policy does not degrade Brier by more than 0.002 vs the frozen baseline on non-drift weeks.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2412.14019v4","title":"Retrieving Classes of Causal Orders with Inconsistent Knowledge Bases (MATS)","normalized_lane":"causal_injury","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"SITUATIONAL","improvement":"Use MATS as an LLM-based causal hypothesis ranker for GSE research questions only, with self-consistency scores calibrated to empirical conditional-independence test p-values weighting the feedback-arc-set objective — and every MATS-proposed edge must survive a data-based test (CI test or IV check) before it ever enters the engine.","gate":"ADAPT as hypothesis-ranker if: the pipeline recovers ≥4/5 known-direction pairs from GSE data AND the enumerated order classes are stable across two different LLMs (rank correlation of pairwise scores >0.7). REJECT any direct use of LLM orders in the engine.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2412.14144","title":"Application of the Kelly Criterion to Prediction Markets","normalized_lane":"sizing","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Add the paper's closed-form Kelly certification test as a pre-bet validity gate and run a gap monitor that flags wide price-vs-resolved-frequency gap markets, then empirically map actual gap distributions by liquidity tier on Polymarket/Kalshi to test whether edge concentrates where the paper predicts (wide-gap, low-liquidity, near-certain-investor regimes).","gate":"ADOPT the closed-form certification test if it passes (correctness property). ADOPT the gap monitor if flagged high-gap markets show realized ROI significantly below average on held-out data (supporting the pass-on-betting rule). REJECT the monitor otherwise.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"DECIDE","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2412.14730v1","title":"Generative AI for Banks: Benchmarks and Algorithms for Synthetic Financial Transaction Data","normalized_lane":"synthetic_data","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"INFRA","improvement":"Adopt the five-category evaluation framework (+ TSTR) as the lane's mandatory acceptance rubric for every GSE synthetic-data generator, and add an explicit graph-reconstruction auxiliary loss (GNN link-prediction head penalizing synthetic tables whose implied matchup graph diverges from the real schedule graph) so every synthetic NFL dataset ships with a NetSimile-vs-real-schedule score.","gate":"ADOPT the five-category framework (+ TSTR) as the lane's mandatory acceptance rubric if: (a) the harness reproduces the paper's qualitative ranking on a finance-adjacent sanity dataset (FinDiff ≥ TVAE ≥ CTGAN on fidelity), AND (b) every lane generator can be scored end-to-end; graph experiment target: NetSimile ≤19 while holding column fidelity ≥0.90.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2412.15673v1","title":"Learning Group Interactions and Semantic Intentions for Multi-Object Trajectory Prediction","normalized_lane":"tracking","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"INFRA","improvement":"Add tactic-conditioned diffusion trajectory prediction to the tracking lane and turn it into a live-pricing scheme-sensitivity engine: generate trajectories under counterfactual defensive schemes (e.g., Cover 2 instead of recognized Cover 3) and widen live-prop uncertainty bands on plays where the factual-vs-counterfactual ΔE[outcome] is large.","gate":"Adopt if the tactic-conditioned model beats the unconditioned diffusion baseline by ≥8% minADE on the weeks 17–18 test window AND auxiliary scheme classification Top-1 ≥ 55%; reject if conditioning gains vanish when tactics are recognized (not given).","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2412.15832","title":"AIFS-CRPS: Ensemble Forecasting Using a Model Trained with a Loss Function Based on CRPS","normalized_lane":"weather","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"SITUATIONAL","improvement":"Train GSE's weather ensemble models with almost-fair CRPS (afCRPS) and combine it with the threshold-weighted twCRPS idea from ledger 0746 into a threshold-weighted almost-fair CRPS that emphasizes tail outcomes while keeping the degeneracy fix — a combination neither paper tries.","gate":"ADOPT afCRPS training if it improves holdout CRPS ≥2% at equal-or-better calibration (PIT uniformity); REJECT if the ensemble collapses (spread → 0) or if gains are <1%.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2412.16454v1","title":"FACTS: Fine-Grained Action Classification for Tactical Sports","normalized_lane":"tracking","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"INFRA","improvement":"Add a synchronized audio stream (broadcast crowd/whistle/pad-crack audio) as a second modality to the VideoMAE action classifier — a two-tower VideoMAE + audio-MAE model on tackle-type/block-shed labels — so audio disambiguates visually occluded contact frames (tackles, blocks, catches) where pure video confuses classes.","gate":"Adopt the video-classification lane if the VideoMAE model beats the pose-based baseline by ≥10 percentage points of test accuracy on the week 16–18 window AND per-class F1 ≥ 0.70 on all 8 classes.","owner":"Hermes","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2412.19215v1","title":"Optimizing Fantasy Sports Team Selection with Deep Reinforcement Learning","normalized_lane":"props_dfs","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Rebuild DFS lineup construction with a two-headed PPO agent: head 1 maximizes projected score (cash-game lineups), head 2 maximizes probability of finishing above the 99th percentile of a field simulator built from public ownership projections (tournament lineups), judged on actual payout EV.","gate":"Accept the adaptation if the PPO agent's mean percentile rank over the 8 held-out NFL slates ≥ the optimizer baseline's mean percentile by ≥ 5 points, with the improvement consistent across ≥ 5 of 8 slates.","owner":"Hermes","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2412.21181v1","title":"Causal Hangover Effects","normalized_lane":"markets","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"BASELINE","improvement":"Gate all situational spots (fatigue/hangover-style angles) through an engine-honesty filter before they ever enter the engine — ATS cover rate ≥ 54.5% over ≥200 occurrences, FDR-adjusted p < 0.05, placebo |effect| < 1.5pp, CLV beat-rate > 50% — and estimate the rest effect as a parametric decay over hours-since-exposure (exponential or spline from 4 to 14 days) rather than short-rest dummies, checking whether the market already prices each point on the curve.","gate":"Adopt a situational spot into the engine only if: (a) ATS cover rate ≥ 54.5% over ≥200 occurrences with FDR-adjusted p < 0.05, AND (b) the placebo (same spot with ≥10 days rest, or neutral-site analogue) shows |effect| < 1.5pp and is non-significant, AND (c) CLV beat-rate > 50%. Otherwise log as noise and reject.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2501.00933v1","title":"Optimizing for Rotisserie Fantasy Basketball","normalized_lane":"props_dfs","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Add a tournament-objective mode to the weekly DFS pipeline that replaces the fixed historical payline with an adaptive payline distribution conditional on slate features (total, pace, chalk ownership), maximizing E_payline[Φ((µ−payline)/σ)] by quadrature so high-total shootout slates build the variance they need.","gate":"ADOPT the GPP objective into the weekly DFS pipeline only if, on the 2024 17-week backtest, tournament-objective lineups beat max-expectation lineups by ≥ 5 pp in cash rate AND the top-1% hit rate is not worse.","owner":"Hermes","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2501.02087v2","title":"Beyond CVaR: Leveraging Static Spectral Risk Measures for Enhanced Decision-Making in Distributional Reinforcement Learning","normalized_lane":"uncertainty_decision_theory","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Run seasonal bet selection under a Mean-CVaR / static spectral risk measure policy, and learn the risk spectrum from Garrett's actual historical override decisions (fit the (α,w) weights that maximize correlation between the policy's implied weekly risk posture and his overrides) so the risk measure is grounded in demonstrated operator risk tolerance, not an arbitrary choice.","gate":"ACCEPT if: on 10k bootstrapped seasons, the Mean-CVaR policy achieves CVaR_{0.2}(season profit) ≥ 1.15 × CVaR_{0.2} of the fixed-threshold baseline AND E[season profit] ≥ 0.95 × baseline expectation (tail protection must cost ≤5% of expectation) AND P(season loss) ≤ 0.8 × baseline.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"CALIBRATE","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2501.05873v1","title":"Forecasting Soccer Matches through Distributions","normalized_lane":"markets","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"BASELINE","improvement":"Replace independent-marginal generative simulation with joint modeling of plays-per-game and EPA-per-play via a copula or conditional model (EPA-per-play | pace decile), since fast high-play games systematically tilt efficiency, to fix the extreme-tail (blowout) miscalibration that independent sampling produces.","gate":"Adopt the simulation-pipeline variant if, on walk-forward 2024 weeks 1–18, its moneyline Brier score beats the bookmaker-consensus-implied Brier by ≥0.002 AND beats GSE's current engine Brier by ≥0.002. Reject if it trails the bookmaker baseline.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2501.07999v2","title":"Unsupervised Feature Construction for Anomaly Detection in Time Series — An Evaluation","normalized_lane":"auto_feature_eng","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Detect steam/shock windows on odds trajectories with a window→catch22→isolation-forest pipeline using jumping (non-overlapping) windows and automatic W selection via FFT-based periodicity detection adapted to weekly sports cadence (7-day odds seasonality, 1-game EPA cadence), which runs at ~1/30th the feature count of tsfresh and is real-time-capable.","gate":"Adopt the window→tsfresh→IF shock detector iff on the 2024–2025 odds-trajectory test it achieves AUC ≥ 0.70 on steam/shock windows AND beats raw-window IF with Wilcoxon p < 0.05, with per-window inference cost < 5 s.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2501.08397","title":"Predict Confidently, Predict Right: Abstention in Dynamic Graph Learning","normalized_lane":"abstention","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Replace the fixed quadratic coverage penalty in GSE's learned abstention head with a Lagrangian dual update (learn λ online to pin exact coverage) and split coverage budgets per market (spread vs total vs moneyline get separate θ), since abstention value differs by market edge distribution.","gate":"ADOPT the method iff, at matched realized coverage (±2 pts), the selection-head model's selective ROI beats the softmax-threshold baseline by ≥ 3 ROI points on the chronological test block AND realized coverage stays within ±3 pts of target across the last 4 weeks of data.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"CALIBRATE","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2501.08710v2","title":"Disentangled Interleaving Variational Encoding","normalized_lane":"calibration","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"BASELINE","improvement":"Adopt a disentangled multi-task architecture for the win/spread/total heads, replacing the Naïve-Bayes marginal loss with a supervised contrastive loss on regime labels (dropping the paper's failed conditional-independence assumption) and learning noisy regime labels jointly via a VQ-VAE codebook instead of hand labels.","gate":"Adopt the architecture if, on 2024–2025 walk-forward, the disentangled multi-task model beats the non-disentangled shared-encoder baseline by ≥0.003 Brier (win prob) or ≥0.1 points MAE vs. close on spread/total, AND achieves MIG ≥ 2× the baseline's.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2501.10299v1","title":"An optimal transport based embedding to quantify the distance between playing styles in collective sports","normalized_lane":"tracking","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"INFRA","improvement":"Build GSE's team-style similarity engine on sliced-Wasserstein embeddings, but quantize the league-wide frame pool once into a shared codebook of formation atoms (\"Cover-2 shell\", \"bunch trips\") and represent each team as a histogram over shared atoms — team similarity becomes a cheap Hellinger distance and the atoms give a human-readable formation taxonomy for free.","gate":"ADOPT the sliced-Wasserstein embedding + quantization pipeline as GSE's team-style similarity engine if the NGS pilot reproduces two paper signatures: (i) embedding beats raw-coordinate baselines on a formation-label prediction task by ≥10 pp, and (ii) the resulting 32×32 similarity matrix correlates ≥0.5 with an independent style proxy (e.g., charted man/zone rates).","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
]

    for r in R:
        f.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')

import json
R = [
{"arxiv_id":"2501.10302","title":"Martingale Approach to Gambler's Ruin Problem for Correlated Random Walks","normalized_lane":"sizing","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Replace the i.i.d. gambler's-ruin bankroll gate with the exact streak-aware ruin formula for correlated weekly P&L signs (fitted 2-state Markov chain), probing a numerically fitted 2nd-order chain to see whether ruin probability moves materially vs k=1 — a direct cheap upgrade to GSE's bankroll gates when weekly results are serially correlated.","gate":"ADOPT the streak-aware gate if the engine's weekly signs show significant persistence (|p − 1/2| > 0.05, binomial test) AND the CRW α differs from the i.i.d. value by > 20% relative (i.e., the correction matters); REJECT if weekly signs are statistically independent.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"DECIDE","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2501.13347v1","title":"One Fits All: General Mobility Trajectory Modeling via Masked Conditional Diffusion (GenMove)","normalized_lane":"selfsupervised_tracking","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Generate synthetic NFL plays with a masked conditional diffusion trajectory model using a formation/personnel controller (11 personnel, shotgun, motion flags) instead of radius-of-gyration, and condition on defensive look (blitz indicators) to generate the offensive plays most likely to exploit it — a direct coaching/scouting tool whose conditional charted-concept distributions must match real ones.","gate":"ADOPT if: (a) generated-play JSD ≤ 0.15 on yards-gained distribution (vs ≥ 0.25 for a Markov baseline), AND (b) zero-shot long-horizon prediction on unseen teams beats the best baseline by ≥ 10% Accuracy@5.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"large","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2501.14755v3","title":"Data-Juicer 2.0: Cloud-Scale Adaptive Data Processing for and with Foundation Models","normalized_lane":"data_infra","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"INFRA","improvement":"Fuse GSE's multi-pass nflverse+corpus processing scripts into a single-pass dedup+filter pipeline with MinHash near-duplicate detection, plus a probe-small-batches adapter (run dedup+filter on a 1% sample to select chunk size and operator order, then apply to the full corpus) to test whether adaptive probing pays off even at GSE's scale.","gate":"ADAPT the patterns iff the fused single-pass pipeline runs ≥30% faster than the current multi-pass scripts on the nflverse+arXiv corpora AND MinHash finds ≥5 near-duplicate pairs missed by exact hashing; reject any Ray/cluster adoption.","owner":"Hermes","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2501.16565v1","title":"Efficient inference of rankings from multi-body comparisons","normalized_lane":"team_ratings","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Model division winners with position-1-breaking Plackett-Luce and extend to the full NFL playoff seed order (7 seeds × 2 conferences, 2002–2025) to test whether entire seed orders carry joint information worth modeling, or whether pairwise/first-place-only structure suffices as in the paper's APA result.","gate":"Adopt position-1-breaking PL for division-winner modeling if, on the 2021–2025 time-ordered test, it matches or beats the market baseline on log-loss (within 0.02) AND beats pairwise BT on top-1 hit rate by ≥1 additional correct division.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2501.18606v1","title":"Temporal Dynamics of Goal Scoring in Soccer","normalized_lane":"experimental","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Add a score-differential × clock burstiness interaction to the live total model: compute same-team burstiness as a function of score differential and time remaining (is the surge stronger when trailing?), turning the paper's pooled burstiness finding into a game-state-conditioned live intensity.","gate":"Adopt if the same-team burstiness effect survives team-strength conditioning — i.e., observed same-team next-score rate in the first 5 minutes after a score exceeds the conditioned null by ≥ 15% relative with χ² p < 0.01 — AND the burstiness-adjusted live intensity improves 2025 second-half total log-loss by ≥ 0.01 nats over the base Poisson model.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2502.00560v4","title":"A Scalable Solver for 2p0s Differential Games with One-Sided Payoff Information and Continuous Actions, States, and Time","normalized_lane":"experimental","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Model play-calling as a one-sided-information game with a ≤2-atom mixture (concealment dynamics), then extend to a repeated game where the defense updates its belief about the offense's type distribution within a drive/game — testing whether belief-updating equilibrium predicts within-game play-calling shifts (e.g., run tendency after two consecutive passes) better than a static model, with adversarial 4th-down modeling as the next step.","gate":"Adopt if the ≤2-atom mixture model beats the logistic baseline by ≥ 0.005 nats of log-loss (or ≥ 0.002 Brier) on 2025 holdout play-by-play, AND a companion deviation analysis shows at least 3 teams with statistically significant (p < 0.05, Bonferroni-corrected) deviations between equilibrium-implied and empirical mixes in any single 2025 game-state bin.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"large","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2502.01613v2","title":"Statistical Enhanced Learning for Modeling and Prediction of Tennis Matches at Grand Slam Tournaments","normalized_lane":"win_spread_total","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"BASELINE","improvement":"Adopt the enhanced feature set over the Elo-only logistic baseline for game-outcome modeling, and learn the shape of the age transform empirically — fit a 1D P-spline on QB age and roster mean age inside a GAM, then distill the fitted spline into a piecewise-linear feature — instead of hand-picking |age−30| / [28,32], producing an interpretable age-curve artifact.","gate":"ADOPT the enhanced feature set if, pre-registered: pooled held-out log-loss improves by ≥ 0.005 over the Elo-only logistic baseline AND the gain appears in ≥ 5 of 7 held-out seasons (consistency, not one lucky year).","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2502.02785v2","title":"OpenSTARLab: Open Approach for Spatio-Temporal Agent Data Analysis in Soccer","normalized_lane":"tracking","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"INFRA","improvement":"Adopt the UIED/SAR schema pattern for GSE's data layer (nflverse + NGS into a single queryable play/frame schema), and replace sparse terminal EPV rewards with dense per-frame reward shaping (per-frame ΔEPA) for any GSE off-ball multi-agent valuation work, addressing paper 0372's off-ball credit-assignment gap.","gate":"ADOPT the UIED/SAR schema pattern for GSE's data layer if a 2-week prototype converts nflverse + NGS into a single queryable play/frame schema with <1% row loss on joins; REJECT porting any OpenSTARLab model to NFL data.","owner":"Hermes","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2502.06884","title":"Learning Conformal Abstention Policies for Adaptive Risk Management in Large Language and Vision-Language Models","normalized_lane":"abstention","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Adopt the two-threshold conformal abstention structure with market-conditional (α, β) per market (spread/total/moneyline) rather than a single global β — moneyline underdogs and totals have different uncertainty geometry — to recover posted picks a global threshold over-abstains on.","gate":"ADAPT iff the three-way policy's selective ROI exceeds the single-threshold conformal baseline by ≥ 2 ROI points on the test block while realized coverage stays ≥ 90% and the abstention rate stays ≤ 25%; REJECT the RL-tuning component unconditionally.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"CALIBRATE","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2502.07255v2","title":"Beyond Confidence: Adaptive Abstention in Dual-Threshold Conformal Prediction for Autonomous System Perception","normalized_lane":"abstention","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Replace the fixed 70%-confidence abstention cutoff with an ROC-tuned dual-threshold conformal policy, and fit separate (q̂_conf, q̂_abs) thresholds per game regime (divisional/non-divisional, weather-affected, short-week) to attack the marginal-vs-conditional coverage gap the paper cites.","gate":"ADAPT if the ROC-tuned abstention threshold beats a fixed 70%-confidence cutoff on test-window published ROI by ≥1pp at comparable coverage, with empirical coverage within ±3pp of the 1−α target.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"DECIDE","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2502.07528v3","title":"Forecasting the Future Development in Quality and Value of Professional Football Players","normalized_lane":"props_dfs","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Add a player-development forecaster to the projection pipeline with a hierarchical mixed-effects age curve: fit a position-specific Bayesian aging curve first and feed each player's residual-vs-curve as the feature, separating age-expected decline from true development signal — targeting the volatile under-24 slice where the paper's models were weakest.","gate":"ADOPT the development forecaster + its intervals into GSE's projection pipeline only if: (a) ≥10% RMSE improvement over carry-forward on 2023–2024 test for at least 3 of 4 positions, (b) empirical 80%-interval coverage within 75–85%, and (c) subgroup slices show no catastrophic failure (RMSE on 2nd-year breakouts no worse than 1.3× overall RMSE).","owner":"Hermes","bucket":"MODEL","effort":"medium","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2502.14710v1","title":"Instrumented Mouthguards for Head Acceleration Events in NCAA Football","normalized_lane":"causal_injury","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"SITUATIONAL","improvement":"Add cumulative head-acceleration-exposure features (imputed from position-group exposure priors) to DNP/availability models, and test whether the offense-side high-magnitude asymmetry (2.6 >30g events/game) predicts measurable late-season offensive-efficiency degradation for high-contact positions (RB/WR/TE) — turning a measurement study into a live fantasy/pick edge while never presenting HAE rates as injury probabilities.","gate":"ADAPT the exposure priors if: the exposure feature improves DNP log-loss by ≥0.003 on the 2025 holdout with monotone direction across position groups. REJECT any direct injury-probability claim.","owner":"Mimo","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"small","depends_on":[]},
{"arxiv_id":"2502.16789v2","title":"AlphaAgent: LLM-Driven Alpha Mining with Regularized Exploration to Counteract Alpha Decay","normalized_lane":"signal_discovery_alpha_mining","verdict":"ADAPT","doctrine_tag":"PROPRIETARY_EDGE","improvement":"Mine alphas with an LLM agent using crowding-aware fitness — penalize similarity to a public-signal proxy zoo (formulas reconstructed from public analytics discourse) so signals resembling what the market already knows (e.g., PFF's public grades) are killed — and make the alignment judge adversarial, with a second LLM arguing against each hypothesis and only survivors kept.","gate":"ADAPT→build if regularized mining shows (a) slower per-season RankIC decay (decay slope ≥ 30% flatter) AND (b) mean pairwise AST similarity ≤ 0.5 vs. ≥ 0.7 unregularized, with test Brier no worse than unregularized. REJECT if regularizers only reduce similarity cosmetically while decay rates match.","owner":"Motif-lab","bucket":"INGEST","effort":"large","depends_on":[]},

REC 1 | arxiv_id=0710.0485v2 | title=Predicting Under the Brier Game with Expert Advice
verdict=ADAPT doctrine=PROPRIETARY_EDGE buckets=['MODEL', 'CALIBRATE']
INDEXGATE: ADOPT SAA as the ensemble combiner iff on the 2024 chronological run it satisfies the regret bound empirically and beats both the simple average and the median expert on mean Brier score...
--- SEC7 ---
- The paper reports the theoretical bound is **"reasonably tight" for football and "particularly tight" for tennis** —
i.e., the algorithm's realized cumulative loss sits close to best-expert loss + ln K, with tennis nearer the bound.
(Qualitative claim as stated; the paper's figures carry the exact loss curves — see full text §5.)
- No raw accuracy or ROI numbers are the point here; the contribution is the guarantee and its empirical tightness.
--- SEC11 ---
- Data: GSE's existing sub-expert probability outputs (model variants, market-implied probabilities from the odds
APIs, analyst-consensus signals) per game, stored with realized outcomes.
- Build: implement SAA exactly — weights w_k ∝ exp(−η·cumulative Brier loss_k) with η = 1; each round's aggregate
prediction = the Brier-mixable generalized prediction over the weighted experts (per the paper's §3 construction). Run
it online over the season: update weights after each slate, publish the aggregate as the ensemble price.
- Add a "market expert" (consensus odds) alongside GSE's internal experts so the regret bound is measured against the
market, not just against ourselves.
- Effort: ~3–5 days (the algorithm is compact; the work is plumbing expert outputs into one panel).
--- SEC12 ---
Dataset: 2023–2024 NFL seasons — per-game probability vectors from each GSE sub-expert + consensus market odds, with
realized outcomes. Baseline: simple average of experts and the single best sub-expert in hindsight. Metric: cumulative
Brier loss over the chronological game sequence. Success: SAA cumulative loss ≤ best-expert loss + ln K (the bound
must hold empirically) AND SAA beats the simple average by ≥ 0.002 mean Brier score.
--- SEC13 ---
ADOPT SAA as the ensemble combiner iff on the 2024 chronological run it satisfies the regret bound empirically and
beats both the simple average and the median expert on mean Brier score. If it merely ties the simple average (within
0.001), reject — the theory is elegant but buys nothing over averaging. Gate set before running the test.
--- SEC14 ---
Weight experts by *recent* Brier loss with exponential decay (a "discounted SAA") instead of full-history cumulative
loss. Why it might win: the paper's bound assumes a fixed best expert; in sports, which expert is best rotates with
regime changes (injuries, weather, market efficiency drift) — discounting lets the aggregation follow the currently-
hot expert, and the ln K bound has known discounted variants, so the theory survives the modification.
