# Bills vs. Lions (Thu 2026-09-17, 7:15 PM CT) — Prop Consensus Research Notes

Research-only file. Nothing here is a pick. Fair use: only line/juice facts were preserved from sources, never article text.

## Method
- Public odds-aggregator / public odds pages only. No logins, paywalls, scraping tricks, invented endpoints, or bot circumvention.
- Every CSV row carries an exact source URL and a real fetch timestamp. Where the source page displayed no update time, `source_page_timestamp` is written as "not displayed" (or the page's own stated stamp) and `fetched_at_ct` records the actual fetch — 2026-09-17 ~14:00 CDT, hours before the 7:15 PM CT kickoff, while lines were still moving.
- Lines moved intraday. The notes below document the observed movement; the CSV holds the most recent verified snapshot.

## Consensus (median / range among comparable standard O/U lines only)
Alternate thresholds (Gibbs 100+ rushing, Kincaid 75+ receiving) and historical/opening lines are kept OUT of the medians.

- **Game total:** current books FanDuel 54.5 (O -114 / U -106) and BetMGM 54.5 (O -112 / U -105) agree at **54.5** — two-book consensus. Historical trail: opener 52.5 (DraftKings, ~3 days earlier) → 53.5 (VSiN, Sep 16) → 54.5 (Sep 17). Full observed range 52.5–54.5.
- **Spread:** FanDuel Bills -4.5 (-115) / Lions +4.5 (-105); BetMGM Bills -5 (-110) / Lions +5 (-108). Current range Bills **-4.5 to -5**. Opened Bills -3 (USA Today, DK preview).
- **Moneyline:** FanDuel Bills -235 / Lions +194; BetMGM Bills -225 / Lions +185; VSiN reports -200 or higher (was -160). Current range roughly Bills **-225 to -235**.
- **Jared Goff passing yards:** FanDuel 257.5 (O -113) vs BetMGM 267.5 (U -115). Range 257.5–267.5, midpoint 262.5. Only two books — treat as a range, not a consensus.
- **Josh Allen passing yards:** DraftKings 250.5 (O -111) is the only book-identified standard line. No cross-book median available.
- **Jahmyr Gibbs rushing yards:** DraftKings 89.5 (O -112) is the only book-identified standard line; BetMGM's 100+ (+115) is an alternate threshold, not comparable.
- **Josh Allen passing TDs:** FanDuel Under 1.5 (+136) is the only book-identified line.
- Everything else in the CSV is a single-book FanDuel line — no cross-book consensus exists from public sources found today.

## Intraday line movement (SportsGrid/FanDuel search snippets vs. live pages, same day)
- Jameson Williams: receptions 3.5 Over -192 → **-148**; longest reception 23.5 Over -122 → **24.5 Over -108**; receiving yards 59.5 Over -113 → **57.5 Over -113**.
- DJ Moore receiving yards: 62.5 → **63.5** (Under -113).
- Khalil Shakir: receptions Over +102 → **+112**; longest reception Over -122 → **-125**.
- Josh Allen passing TDs: Under 1.5 +134 → **+136**.
- James Cook longest reception: Over -112 → **-114**.

## Book-unspecified lines (in notes only, NOT in CSV as book rows)
- FTW anytime TDs (book not named on page): Gibbs -330, St. Brown +105, Kincaid +170, DJ Moore +150. Source: https://ftw.usatoday.com/story/sports/nfl/2026/09/17/lions-bills-anytime-td-scorer-predictions/91796651007/
- HelloRookie QB markets (book not named): Allen passing yards 248.5 Over -114; Goff passing yards 265.5 Over -111 ("some books" 270.5 Over -114); Allen passing TDs 1.5 Over -166. Article says Allen opened ~219.5–223.5 before steaming toward 250. Source: https://hellorookie.com/3-qb-passing-props-to-back-for-lions-vs-bills-on-tnf/
- VSiN/Review-Journal: Dawson Knox Over 12.5 receiving yards (-114); says 12.5 still available "at several sportsbooks" without naming one. OptaAI projection cited: 22.48 yards. Source: https://www.reviewjournal.com/sports/betting/thursday-night-football-betting-avoid-the-game-lines-play-the-props-3887074/
- USA Today preview: Gibbs rushing + receiving 119.5 (side Over, juice/book not shown); total moved ~52.5 to 54.5.
- PrizePicks (DFS, not a sportsbook — excluded from book consensus): DJ Moore receiving yards 62.5; Jameson Williams receptions 4. Source: https://www.si.com/onsi/fantasy/dfs/josh-allen-and-3-other-prizepicks-props-bills-lions-thursday-night-football

## Gaps (searched, not found publicly)
- **Pinnacle / Circa:** no public Pinnacle or Circa player-prop numbers found anywhere today. Gap stands.
- **Defensive props:** SportsGrid renders no defensive markets — checked Aidan Hutchinson, Alim McNeill, Greg Rousseau player pages; no sacks/tackles lines anywhere. No other public source showed them.
- **Kicking props:** no individual Tyler Bass / Jake Bates prop lines found. Only team-level kicking market: BetMGM "Both teams to make 2+ field goals" +275 (SportsbookWire).
- **First TD scorer:** no public first-TD board found.
- **Amon-Ra St. Brown FanDuel receiving props:** the PICKS section of his SportsGrid page failed to render on two separate opens. FanDuel-side ASB receiving lines are a gap; book-identified ASB lines are DraftKings receptions 7.5 Over -111 (SI) and SIA anytime TD +115.
- **Jahmyr Gibbs FanDuel rushing yards:** not among the markets SportsGrid displayed (only receiving markets shown).
- **Under juice:** SportsGrid pages show only the Over-side price for O/U markets, so full two-way pricing is unavailable there.
- **Multi-book aggregators:** FantasyPros player-props page failed to fetch; Covers, OddsShark, VegasInsider, Pickswise, SportsLine surfaced no rendered multi-book player-prop table; RotoWire's game page showed team implied totals but player props stayed "Loading Possible Bets." No true current multi-book prop table was reachable from public pages today.

## Source ranking (by usable book-identified coverage for this game)
1. **SportsGrid** — 30 FanDuel prop rows across 10 players; live, single-book, over-side prices only.
2. **SportsbookWire** — 5 BetMGM markets with an explicit page timestamp (8:02 AM CT), plus game lines with timestamps.
3. **SI (betting)** — 3 DraftKings core props.
4. **FTW** — full FanDuel game lines (spread/ML/total); 4 anytime-TD prices with book unnamed.
5. **Sports Interaction** — 2 book-identified anytime-TD lines (St. Brown +115, Gibbs -275).
6. **Action Network** — 1 book-identified anytime-TD line (LaPorta +230 bet365; note the article's own body text says +220 — discrepancy recorded in CSV).
7. **HelloRookie / VSiN / USA Today** — contextual or book-unspecified lines, movement evidence only.
8. **RotoWire / FantasyPros / Covers / OddsShark / VegasInsider / Pickswise / SportsLine** — no usable rendered prop data today.

## Roster corrections verified today
- **David Montgomery plays for Houston, not Detroit** (BUF held HOU's Montgomery to 60 rush yards in Week 1; SI and SportsGrid rosters confirm). No Detroit Montgomery prop exists. He was omitted, not missed.
- **DJ Moore plays for Buffalo** (acquired from Chicago for a 2026 second-round pick). All his lines are BUF lines. NBC noted he "leaves late in game" in Week 1 (5/100/1) — verify his status before kickoff.
- Detroit's listed RBs behind Gibbs are Sione Vaki and Jacob Saylors; Detroit's kicker is Jake Bates, Buffalo's is Tyler Bass.

## Game context flags (not lines)
- Week 1: Bills 36–31 at Houston; Lions 31–30 OT vs. New Orleans. First regular-season game in the new $2.1B Highmark Stadium.
- Detroit secondary injuries: safeties Brian Branch and Kerby Joseph on PUP; CB D.J. Reed questionable (foot); CB D.J. Reed (foot) per SI depth chart.
- Weather: one source flags possible rain/wind in Buffalo Thursday — could matter for kicking props.
- RotoWire's Week 1 sheet (not this game) had Jake Bates Over 8.5 kicking points (-111 DK) — do NOT use as a Week 2 number.

title: qb-behavioral-profiles/README.md
body:
# QB Behavioral Profiles

Data-backed behavioral profiles for NFL quarterbacks, built from nflverse
play-by-play (2010–2026). Numbers, not adjectives.

## What this is

Garrett's directive (2026-10-01): the engine's reasoning must be
**player-specific and deep**, not category-based. A "veteran QB" label
predicts nothing — Case Keenum spreads it around, Aaron Rodgers fixates on
guys he trusts. The unit of analysis is the player. These profiles quantify
the behavioral patterns: target fixation (HHI), trust targets, INT
situational splits, run behavior, EPA splits.

## Pipeline

```
code/download_pbp.py    -> data/pbp_<season>.parquet   (nflverse via nflreadpy)
code/compute_metrics.py -> data/qb_season_metrics.parquet
                           data/by_qb/<qb>.csv
code/gen_profiles.py    -> profiles/<qb>.md
```

Run inside the venv: `.venv/bin/python code/<script>.py`

Key implementation notes:
- QB identity uses `passer_player_id` (GSIS), mapped to canonical full names
  via nflverse rosters — required because pre-2019 seasons use abbreviated
  names ("A.Rodgers") while newer seasons use full names.
- Min 100 dropbacks per QB-season.
- "Hit" INT proxy: `qb_hit==1` on the attempt (sacks excluded by construction).
- Designed rushes: rusher is the QB, not a scramble/kneel/spike.

## Metrics per QB-season

1. **Target concentration**: HHI of target shares (0–1), top-1/top-2 shares,
   league median for context.
2. **Trust targets**: top receiver + share on 3rd down and in the red zone
   (opp 20 and in).
3. **INT situational splits**: per 100 attempts — overall, by quarter, by game
   script (leading/tied/trailing), hit vs clean.
4. **Run behavior**: scramble rate, designed rush count/rate.
5. **EPA/dropback**: overall, by script, by quarter.

## Known limitations (queued)

- **Scheme splits (man vs zone, blitz vs no-blitz)**: not present in nflverse
  pbp columns. Needs NGS charting or SIS/PFF data.
- **True pressure rate**: nflverse pbp has no per-play pressure flag; the
  qb_hit proxy is outcome-based, not process-based.
- **2026**: weeks 1–3 only at build time.
- Trust-signal intake (player/coach quotes, e.g. the Rodgers–Metcalf video)
  is a separate social/video pipeline, not covered here.

## Status

Built 2026-10-01 by Motif coordinator. See profiles/ for the eight
founding QBs: Rodgers, Watson, Keenum, Mahomes, Allen, Burrow, Hurts, Jackson.

title: qb-behavioral-profiles/code/compute_metrics.py
body:
"""Compute per-QB-season behavioral metrics from nflverse pbp parquet files.

QB identity via passer_player_id (GSIS, stable across the 2019 name-format
change); canonical full names from nflverse rosters.

Outputs ../data/qb_season_metrics.parquet and per-QB CSVs in ../data/by_qb/.
"""
import polars as pl
import nflreadpy as nfl
import os

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DATA = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "data")
BYQB = os.path.join(DATA, "by_qb")
os.makedirs(BYQB, exist_ok=True)

MIN_DB = 100

print("loading rosters 2010-2026...", flush=True)
rost = nfl.load_rosters(list(range(2010, 2027)))
id2name = dict(rost.filter(pl.col("gsis_id").is_not_null())
               .select("gsis_id", "full_name").unique().iter_rows())
print(f"{len(id2name)} id->name mappings", flush=True)


def canon(pid):
    return id2name.get(pid, pid or "unknown")


def with_script(df):
    return df.with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("score_differential") > 0).then(pl.lit("leading"))
          .when(pl.col("score_differential") < 0).then(pl.lit("trailing"))
          .otherwise(pl.lit("tied")).alias("script"))


def target_stats(df):
    """HHI + top shares + top receiver (canonical names), per passer id."""
    tg = (df.filter(pl.col("pass_attempt") == 1)
            .filter(pl.col("passer_player_id").is_not_null() & pl.col("receiver_player_id").is_not_null())
            .group_by(["passer_player_id", "receiver_player_id"])
            .agg(pl.len().alias("targets")))
    tot = tg.group_by("passer_player_id").agg(pl.sum("targets").alias("tot"))
    tg = tg.join(tot, on="passer_player_id").with_columns(
        (pl.col("targets") / pl.col("tot")).alias("share"))
    hhi = (tg.group_by("passer_player_id")
             .agg((pl.col("share").pow(2).sum()).alias("hhi"),
                  pl.col("share").max().alias("top1_share"),
                  pl.col("share").sort(descending=True).head(2).sum().alias("top2_share"),
                  pl.first("tot").alias("targets")))
    top_recv = (tg.sort(["passer_player_id", "share"], descending=[False, True])
                  .group_by("passer_player_id").first()
                  .select("passer_player_id",
                          pl.col("receiver_player_id").alias("top_recv_id")))
    return hhi, top_recv


def trust_top(df, filt, label):
    sub = df.filter(filt & (pl.col("pass_attempt") == 1)
                    & pl.col("passer_player_id").is_not_null()
                    & pl.col("receiver_player_id").is_not_null())
    if len(sub) == 0:
        return None
    tg = (sub.group_by(["passer_player_id", "receiver_player_id"])
              .agg(pl.len().alias("t")))
    tot = tg.group_by("passer_player_id").agg(pl.sum("t").alias("tot"))
    tg = tg.join(tot, on="passer_player_id").with_columns((pl.col("t") / pl.col("tot")).alias("s"))
    return (tg.sort(["passer_player_id", "s"], descending=[False, True])
              .group_by("passer_player_id").first()
              .select("passer_player_id",
                      pl.col("receiver_player_id").alias(f"{label}_recv_id"),
                      pl.col("s").alias(f"{label}_share"),
                      pl.col("tot").alias(f"{label}_targets")))


rows = []
seasons = sorted(int(f.split("_")[1].split(".")[0])
                 for f in os.listdir(DATA) if f.startswith("pbp_") and f.endswith(".parquet"))

for season in seasons:
    raw = with_script(pl.read_parquet(os.path.join(DATA, f"pbp_{season}.parquet")))
    # nflfastR leaves passer_player_id null on scrambles; backfill from rusher
    df = raw.with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("passer_player_id").is_null() & (pl.col("qb_scramble") == 1))
          .then(pl.col("rusher_player_id"))
          .otherwise(pl.col("passer_player_id")).alias("passer_player_id")
    ).filter(pl.col("passer_player_id").is_not_null())
    qbs = (df.filter(pl.col("qb_dropback") == 1)
             .group_by("passer_player_id").agg(pl.len().alias("dropbacks"))
             .filter(pl.col("dropbacks") >= MIN_DB))

    hhi, toprecv = target_stats(df)
    d3 = trust_top(df, pl.col("down") == 3, "third")
    rz = trust_top(df, pl.col("yardline_100") <= 20, "rz")

    base = qbs.join(hhi, on="passer_player_id", how="left").join(toprecv, on="passer_player_id", how="left")
    if d3 is not None:
        base = base.join(d3, on="passer_player_id", how="left")
    if rz is not None:
        base = base.join(rz, on="passer_player_id", how="left")

    for r in base.iter_rows(named=True):
        pid, qb = r["passer_player_id"], canon(r["passer_player_id"])
        qd = df.filter((pl.col("passer_player_id") == pid) & (pl.col("qb_dropback") == 1))
        att = qd.filter(pl.col("pass_attempt") == 1)
        n_att, n_db = len(att), len(qd)
        n_int = att.select(pl.col("interception").sum()).item() or 0
        n_scr = qd.select(pl.col("qb_scramble").sum()).item() or 0
        epa_db = qd.select(pl.col("epa").mean()).item()

        def intrate(a):
            if len(a) == 0:
                return None, 0
            i = a.select(pl.col("interception").sum()).item() or 0
            return round(100 * i / len(a), 2), len(a)

        int_q = {q: intrate(att.filter(pl.col("qtr") == q)) for q in [1, 2, 3, 4]}
        int_s = {s: intrate(att.filter(pl.col("script") == s)) for s in ["leading", "tied", "trailing"]}
        a_hit = att.filter(pl.col("qb_hit") == 1)
        a_clean = att.filter(pl.col("qb_hit").fill_null(0) == 0)
        int_hit = intrate(a_hit)
        int_clean = intrate(a_clean)

        des = raw.filter((pl.col("rusher_player_id") == pid) &
                         (pl.col("rush_attempt") == 1) &
                         (pl.col("qb_scramble").fill_null(0) == 0) &
                         (pl.col("qb_kneel").fill_null(0) == 0) &
                         (pl.col("qb_spike").fill_null(0) == 0))
        n_des = len(des)

        def epamean(d):
            v = d.select(pl.col("epa").mean()).item()
            return round(v or 0, 3)

        epa_s = {s: epamean(qd.filter(pl.col("script") == s)) for s in ["leading", "tied", "trailing"]}
        epa_q = {q: epamean(qd.filter(pl.col("qtr") == q)) for q in [1, 2, 3, 4]}

        rows.append({
            "season": season, "qb": qb,
            "dropbacks": n_db, "attempts": n_att,
            "hhi": round(r["hhi"] or 0, 4),
            "top1_share": round(r["top1_share"] or 0, 4),
            "top2_share": round(r["top2_share"] or 0, 4),
            "top_receiver": canon(r["top_recv_id"]),
            "third_top_recv": canon(r["third_recv_id"]) if r.get("third_recv_id") else None,
            "third_top_share": round(r["third_share"], 4) if r.get("third_share") else None,
            "third_targets": r.get("third_targets"),
            "rz_top_recv": canon(r["rz_recv_id"]) if r.get("rz_recv_id") else None,
            "rz_top_share": round(r["rz_share"], 4) if r.get("rz_share") else None,
            "rz_targets": r.get("rz_targets"),
            "int_rate": round(100 * n_int / n_att, 2) if n_att else None,
            "ints": n_int,
            "int_q1": int_q[1][0], "int_q1_n": int_q[1][1],
            "int_q2": int_q[2][0], "int_q2_n": int_q[2][1],
            "int_q3": int_q[3][0], "int_q3_n": int_q[3][1],
            "int_q4": int_q[4][0], "int_q4_n": int_q[4][1],
            "int_lead": int_s["leading"][0], "int_lead_n": int_s["leading"][1],
            "int_tied": int_s["tied"][0], "int_tied_n": int_s["tied"][1],
            "int_trail": int_s["trailing"][0], "int_trail_n": int_s["trailing"][1],
            "int_hit": int_hit[0], "int_hit_n": int_hit[1],
            "int_clean": int_clean[0], "int_clean_n": int_clean[1],
            "scramble_rate": round(n_scr / n_db, 4) if n_db else None,
            "scrambles": n_scr,
            "designed_rushes": n_des,
            "designed_rush_rate": round(n_des / (n_db + n_des), 4) if (n_db + n_des) else None,
            "epa_db": round(epa_db or 0, 3),
            "epa_lead": epa_s["leading"], "epa_tied": epa_s["tied"], "epa_trail": epa_s["trailing"],
            "epa_q1": epa_q[1], "epa_q2": epa_q[2], "epa_q3": epa_q[3], "epa_q4": epa_q[4],
        })
    print(f"{season}: {base.height} QBs", flush=True)

out = pl.DataFrame(rows)
out.write_parquet(os.path.join(DATA, "qb_season_metrics.parquet"))
for qb in out["qb"].unique().to_list():
    sub = out.filter(pl.col("qb") == qb).sort("season")
    safe = "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "_" for c in qb)
    sub.write_csv(os.path.join(BYQB, f"{safe}.csv"))
print(f"wrote {len(out)} rows, {out['qb'].n_unique()} QBs", flush=True)

body:
"""Download nflverse play-by-play 2010-2026, one parquet per season in ../data/."""
import nflreadpy as nfl
import os

DATA = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "data")

for season in range(2010, 2027):
    out = os.path.join(DATA, f"pbp_{season}.parquet")
    if os.path.exists(out):
        print(f"{season}: cached", flush=True)
        continue
    try:
        pbp = nfl.load_pbp([season])
        pbp.write_parquet(out)
        print(f"{season}: {len(pbp)} rows -> {out}", flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{season}: FAILED {type(e).__name__}: {e}", flush=True)

body:
"""Render markdown behavioral profiles from qb_season_metrics.parquet.

Usage: python gen_profiles.py
Writes ../profiles/<qb>.md for each QB in TARGETS.
"""
import polars as pl
import os

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DATA = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "data")
PROF = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "profiles")
os.makedirs(PROF, exist_ok=True)

TARGETS = [
    "Aaron Rodgers", "Deshaun Watson", "Case Keenum",
    "Patrick Mahomes", "Josh Allen", "Joe Burrow",
    "Jalen Hurts", "Lamar Jackson",
]

MCCARTHY_RODGERS = range(2010, 2019)  # McCarthy HC of GB through Dec 2018

m = pl.read_parquet(os.path.join(DATA, "qb_season_metrics.parquet"))
lg_hhi = (m.group_by("season").agg(pl.col("hhi").median().alias("lg_med_hhi"),
                                   pl.col("top1_share").median().alias("lg_med_top1")))

def fmt(x, nd=3):
    if x is None:
        return "—"
    try:
        return f"{float(x):.{nd}f}"
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return "—"

def pct(x):
    return "—" if x is None else f"{x:.1%}"

def profile(qb):
    d = m.filter(pl.col("qb") == qb).sort("season")
    if len(d) == 0:
        return f"# {qb}\n\nNo seasons with 100+ dropbacks in 2010-2026.\n"
    d = d.join(lg_hhi, on="season", how="left")
    L = [f"# QB Behavioral Profile: {qb}",
         f"\nSeasons: {d['season'].min()}–{d['season'].max()} ({len(d)} qualifying seasons, min 100 dropbacks). nflverse play-by-play.",
         "\n## 1. Target concentration (HHI of target shares, 0–1 scale)",
         "\nHigher HHI = more passes funneled to fewer receivers. League median shown for context.",
         "\n| Season | Dropbacks | HHI | Lg med HHI | Top-1 share | Lg med Top-1 | Top-2 share | #1 target |",
         "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in d.iter_rows(named=True):
        tag = " *" if qb == "Aaron Rodgers" and r["season"] in MCCARTHY_RODGERS else ""
        L.append(f"| {r['season']}{tag} | {r['dropbacks']} | {fmt(r['hhi'])} | {fmt(r['lg_med_hhi'])} | "
                 f"{pct(r['top1_share'])} | {pct(r['lg_med_top1'])} | {pct(r['top2_share'])} | {r['top_receiver']} |")
    if qb == "Aaron Rodgers":
        L.append("\n*McCarthy as head coach (fired Dec 2018).")
    avg_hhi = d.select(pl.col("hhi").mean()).item()
    avg_top1 = d.select(pl.col("top1_share").mean()).item()
    L += [f"\nCareer-average HHI: {fmt(avg_hhi)} | Career-average top-1 share: {pct(avg_top1)}",
          "\n## 2. Trust targets (3rd down / red zone)",
          "\nTop receiver's share on 3rd down and in the red zone (opp 20 and in) vs his overall share.",
          "\n| Season | 3rd-down #1 | 3rd share | 3rd tgts | RZ #1 | RZ share | RZ tgts |",
          "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in d.iter_rows(named=True):
        L.append(f"| {r['season']} | {r['third_top_recv'] or '—'} | {pct(r['third_top_share'])} | "
                 f"{r['third_targets'] or '—'} | {r['rz_top_recv'] or '—'} | {pct(r['rz_top_share'])} | {r['rz_targets'] or '—'} |")
    L += ["\n## 3. Interception situational splits (rate per 100 attempts)",
          "\nHit-proxy = attempt on which the QB took a hit (qb_hit=1); clean = no hit recorded.",
          "\n| Season | Overall | n | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 | Q4 | Lead | Tied | Trail | Hit | Clean |",
          "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in d.iter_rows(named=True):
        L.append(f"| {r['season']} | {fmt(r['int_rate'],2)} | {r['ints']}/{r['attempts']} | "
                 f"{fmt(r['int_q1'],2)} | {fmt(r['int_q2'],2)} | {fmt(r['int_q3'],2)} | {fmt(r['int_q4'],2)} | "
                 f"{fmt(r['int_lead'],2)} | {fmt(r['int_tied'],2)} | {fmt(r['int_trail'],2)} | "
                 f"{fmt(r['int_hit'],2)} | {fmt(r['int_clean'],2)} |")
    L += ["\n## 4. Run behavior",
          "\n| Season | Scramble rate | Scrambles | Designed rushes | Designed rate |",
          "|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in d.iter_rows(named=True):
        L.append(f"| {r['season']} | {pct(r['scramble_rate'])} | {r['scrambles']} | {r['designed_rushes']} | {pct(r['designed_rush_rate'])} |")
    L += ["\n## 5. EPA per dropback splits",
          "\n| Season | Overall | Lead | Tied | Trail | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 | Q4 |",
          "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in d.iter_rows(named=True):
        L.append(f"| {r['season']} | {fmt(r['epa_db'])} | {fmt(r['epa_lead'])} | {fmt(r['epa_tied'])} | "
                 f"{fmt(r['epa_trail'])} | {fmt(r['epa_q1'])} | {fmt(r['epa_q2'])} | {fmt(r['epa_q3'])} | {fmt(r['epa_q4'])} |")
    L += ["\n## Notes",
          "- HHI computed on all targeted receivers (pass_attempt=1). Min 100 dropbacks/season.",
          "- INT 'hit' proxy uses qb_hit flag; sacks excluded from attempt-based rates by construction.",
          "- Scheme splits (man vs zone, blitz vs no-blitz) unavailable in nflverse pbp; queued for NGS/charting data.",
          "- 2026 data covers weeks 1–3 only."]
    return "\n".join(L) + "\n"

for qb in TARGETS:
    safe = "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "_" for c in qb)
    with open(os.path.join(PROF, f"{safe}.md"), "w") as f:
        f.write(profile(qb))
    print("wrote", qb, flush=True)
